value.rationale: The four-tap support threshold is a natural minimum-support full phase-retrieval design problem on eleven cyclic sites, not an arbitrary numerical slice: six unordered edges just cover five classes, making exactly one repeated lag and a universal nontrivial phase frustration. The exact best stability constant, complete root-of-unity optimizer family, and >2 amplitude reweighting gap clarify a concrete design limitation for phase-only sparse Gabor tomography. No global weighted optimum is claimed; this is a motivated sharp boundary with a reproducible exact counterdesign.
